newsitem.title: USA: BPA CUTS FIRM, PEAK POWER FOR FRIDAY $11-15 A MWH.
newsitem.headline: BPA CUTS FIRM, PEAK POWER FOR FRIDAY $11-15 A MWH.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said it has cut its offer for firm, peak electricity for Friday by $11.00-15.00 per megawatt hour (MWh).
The federal agency offered 200 MW of firm, peak electricity for Friday delivery at $24.00 per MWh for Northwest delivery and $27.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) delivery.
BPA also offered 400 MW of off-peak electricity at $16.00 for Northwest and COB deliveries.
On Wednesday, BPA only offered to sell surplus peak, firm power for Thursday at $35.00 for Northwest delivery and $42.00 for COB delivery.
